note: Student and staff counts from rdfindia.org/our-institutions (2025-26). Update once a year from RDF.

institutions.name: RDF Kalleda
institutions.blurb: The first school. It opened with 80 children in a portion of the Erraballi family home and is still RDF's flagship, where new programs are piloted. Its students have represented India in archery and won the state science fair.

institutions.name: RDF Matendla
institutions.blurb: Began under the trees in a village that had no school at all. Now the largest RDF school, with science and computer labs, a dining hall, a school bus and its own water plant.

institutions.name: RDF Redlawada
institutions.blurb: Telugu-medium primary school with English from grade one. Its organic garden supplies vegetables for the mid-day meal here and at other RDF schools.

institutions.name: RDF Rollakal
institutions.blurb: Classes started in an open field. Infor employees funded and painted the building, inaugurated in 2013. Two fourth-graders were selected for the state sports school in 2019.

institutions.name: RDF Vanitha Achuta Pai Junior College
institutions.blurb: English-medium junior college with day and residential places, known for archery and for sending students to the national Inspire science program. Washington University students have taught mini-courses here since 2007.
